title: feat(c5q6): cov5>0 is not Q6; positivity implies Q6
science: Exact one-way law over the full 32-map class (pos_implies_Q6=1, Q6_FALSE_POS empty, N_pos=N_both=21) plus an ANOMALY the note never remarks on: the seven Q6-true zeros are the four vertex3-only maps (0,*,0,1,*) and three of the four wt1-only maps, leaving (1,1,0,0,1) as the SOLE 5-site-positive map with adj2=0 and vertex3=0. So cov5>0 is not adj2 OR vertex3 (the k=7/k=11 law) - it is (adj2 OR (wt1 AND vertex3)) plus that one exception, and the exception is exactly the map carrying wt1 AND opp2 AND mixed3. Note also that the four vertex3-only maps are 5-site ZERO here but 7-site and 11-site POSITIVE (#6615/#6616), so coverage positivity is non-monotone in k for those maps. Prose is internally consistent; seed-count arithmetic C(12,5)=792 correct.
